keywords.title: Keywords (any)
keywords.description: Keep notices whose title or description contains at least one keyword (case-insensitive).

cpvPrefixes.title: CPV code prefixes
cpvPrefixes.description: Keep notices with a CPV code starting with one of these digits, e.g. 72 (IT services), 45 (construction), 85 (health and social services), 7222.

regions.title: Buyer region (NUTS/ITL prefix)
regions.description: Keep notices whose buyer address region starts with one of these codes, e.g. UKI (London), UKM (Scotland), UKL (Wales), UKN (Northern Ireland).

minValue.title: Minimum value (GBP)
minValue.description: Keep notices with an estimated value (or, for awards, the total contract value) at or above this amount. Notices without a value are excluded when set.

maxValue.title: Maximum value (GBP)
maxValue.description: Keep notices with an estimated total value at or below this amount.

onlyOpen.title: Only open tenders
onlyOpen.description: Keep only notices that can still be responded to: tender deadline (or expression-of-interest deadline) in the future, not cancelled/withdrawn.

updatedFrom.title: Updated from
updatedFrom.description: Start of the publication/update window (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: the last 'Days back' days.

updatedTo.title: Updated to
updatedTo.description: End of the window (YYYY-MM-DD, the whole day is included). Default: now.

onlyNew.title: Monitoring mode: only new notices
onlyNew.description: Remember notices (and amended versions) already returned and output only new ones. Schedule daily.

stateKey.title: Monitoring state key
stateKey.description: Separate 'already seen' list per search. Do not run two schedules with the same key at the same time.

maxItems.title: Max notices
maxItems.description: Maximum number of notices to output.

requestIntervalMs.title: Delay between API pages (ms)
requestIntervalMs.description: Pause between API requests (100 notices per page).
